rows.corpus_definition: A sudden shaking of the ground that causes damage.
rows.example_en: The earthquake moved the furniture in our house.

rows.corpus_definition: Have a meal at a restaurant instead of your house.
rows.example_en: Let us eat out at that new Italian place.

rows.corpus_definition: To make changes to a text or video to improve it.
rows.example_en: You need to edit your report for mistakes.

rows.corpus_definition: A result or change caused by something.
rows.example_en: The medicine had a good effect on him.

rows.corpus_definition: A person who is paid to do a job for someone else.
rows.example_en: The company treats every employee with great respect.

rows.corpus_definition: a person who is paid to work for someone
rows.example_en: The company has over one hundred employees.

rows.corpus_definition: A person or company that gives people jobs to do for money.
rows.example_en: My employer is very kind and supportive.

rows.corpus_definition: the person or business that pays people to work
rows.example_en: My employer gave me a week off.

rows.corpus_definition: To keep people interested and happy.
rows.example_en: The clown will entertain the kids.

rows.corpus_definition: Something that is interesting and gives you enjoyment.
rows.example_en: That film was very entertaining and funny.

rows.corpus_definition: Shows, films, or games that people enjoy.
rows.example_en: This city has great nightlife entertainment.

rows.corpus_definition: Feeling very interested and excited about something.
rows.example_en: He is very enthusiastic about the new project.

rows.corpus_definition: showing strong excitement and interest about something
rows.example_en: The students were enthusiastic about the new science project.
